Module org.firebirdsql.jaybird
Package org.firebirdsql.gds.ng

Class StatementInfoProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.firebirdsql.gds.ng.StatementInfoProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
InfoProcessor<InfoProcessor.StatementInfo>
public final class StatementInfoProcessor extends Object implements InfoProcessor<InfoProcessor.StatementInfo>
InfoProcessor to retrieve the statement information associated with AbstractFbStatement.getStatementInfoRequestItems() and AbstractFbStatement.getParameterDescriptionInfoRequestItems().
